name: John H. Watson
source:
John is kind to women, if you put that trait in a good light you could say he's gentlemanly, or you could call him a playboy. He pays no attention to status differences and treats Jane as a lady. He wants to live at the lodging house on 221B Baker Street.

[From the [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/006/eng/index.html]official website[/url]]
